subject: design/solution-shape-v1
statement: A docgate check enforces the split, fail-closed (AP-17), reusing docgate's check + defects-as-data pattern rather than a new tool (the emitted defects are enumerated in §3.4): a frozen design carrying concrete shape fails (DINV-1); a shape admitted to the design index fails (DINV-3); an unwitnessed invariant or untraceable shape element fails (DINV-4). The witness/trace check (DINV-4) keys on the binding markup already parsed for the design class, so the partition needs no new tagging grammar — *which file* it lives in is the tag.
